security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, metadata, or descriptive paths. Semantic review found mutable dependency installation and authenticated physical-device changes.

remediation.issue: The installer references the mutable @latest version of eightctl.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the Go module to a reviewed release version and update it through a controlled review process.

remediation.issue: Several commands can change pod, alarm, audio, schedule, or base behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before every mutating command and display the intended action before execution.

content.user_title: Control Eight Sleep Pods with eightctl
content.value_statement: Managing pod settings across separate controls can be slow and inconsistent. This skill guides authenticated eightctl commands for status, temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base settings.
actual_capabilities: Check Eight Sleep pod status through the installed eightctl CLI.
Turn the pod on or off after user confirmation.
Set a requested pod temperature after user confirmation.
List, create, update, or dismiss alarms and schedules.
Inspect or control supported audio and adjustable base functions.
limitations: The eightctl binary and valid Eight Sleep credentials must already be available.
The integration uses an unofficial, rate-limited API that may change without notice.
The skill lists command families but does not document every required option.
Device availability, account permissions, and hardware support determine which actions succeed.

use_cases.title: Check Bedside Status
use_cases.description: Review current pod state before changing any setting.

use_cases.title: Manage Sleep Schedules
use_cases.description: List and adjust recurring schedules or alarms with confirmation.

use_cases.title: Operate Supported Hardware
use_cases.description: Control audio or adjustable base functions through guided commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check Pod Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Eight Sleep pod status and summarize the result. Do not change any settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a read-only status check.

prompt_templates.title: Set a Temperature
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to set my pod temperature to 20. Show the intended change and ask for confirmation before running it.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants one controlled temperature change.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Alarm
prompt_templates.prompt: List my existing alarms, then help create an alarm for [time] on [days]. Confirm the final details before making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants to review and modify alarm settings.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Pod Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review status, schedules, alarms, audio, and base state. Propose changes for [goal], identify unsupported details, and confirm each mutating action.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user wants a coordinated device plan.

output_examples.input: Check my pod status without changing anything.
output_examples.output: The pod status check completed. The response summarizes current state and reports any unavailable fields without modifying settings.
Planned change: set the pod temperature to 20. Confirmation is required before the command runs.

output_examples.input: Show my schedules and help update weekdays.
output: Current schedules are listed in a readable summary.
The proposed weekday update is shown for review.
No schedule changes occur until confirmation.

best_practices: Use status and list commands before changing device settings.
Confirm every mutating action, especially temperature, power, alarms, schedules, audio, and base position.
Avoid repeated logins and group related read-only checks when possible.
anti_patterns: Do not display, log, or repeat account credentials in responses.
Do not run mutating commands without explicit confirmation.
Do not retry failed authentication or API calls in rapid loops.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: The eightctl binary must be installed and accessible in the command environment.

faq.question: How does eightctl authenticate?
faq.answer: It can use its configuration file or the documented email and password environment variables.

faq.question: Can this skill change pod temperature?
faq.answer: Yes. It should show the requested temperature and receive explicit confirmation before changing it.

faq.question: Can it manage alarms and schedules?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents list, create, dismiss, and update command families, although additional options may be required.

faq.question: Does it support audio and adjustable bases?
faq.answer: It documents audio state, playback controls, base information, and base angle commands for supported hardware.

faq.question: Is the Eight Sleep API official?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that the API is unofficial and rate-limited, so behavior may change.
